body.x: The CES started in New York in 1967 and has been running for 50 years. The event has served as an international stage for innovation as a venue for leaders in the electronics technology industry to gather to announce their technologies and products

Growing as the world's largest electronic technology event, the CES attracted 117 companies at its first event. This year's CES 2020 is expected to draw more than 4,500 companies from 160 countries and more than 170,000 visitors. How could CES grow like this?

The biggest reason CES has been able to grow is its global scale. As companies from various countries participate, the related technology industry can gain the effect of promoting while competing. In addition, not only start-up companies, but also Korea’s large companies such as Samsung and LG, as well as Google, Amazon, Facebook and Apple, which are also called ‘GAFA’, can participate and experience advanced technologies.

The CES, where portable radio, camcorders, DVD players, IP TVs, tablets and drones were first announced, is focusing on what other cutting-edge technologies and products will be announced this time. This year's CES 2020 will feature technologies such as AI, automotive and healthcare digitalization and 8k.
